newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kuala Lumpur's business area hit by power cut.
newsitem.headline: Kuala Lumpur's business area hit by power cut.

text.p: The business district in the Malaysian capital was hit by a power outage on Tuesday afternoon and utility officials could not immediately say when electricity would be restored.

"We've got many calls from affected consumers in Jalan Sultan Ismail, Jalan Raja Chulan and Jalan Bukit Bintang," said a spokesman for state power utility Tenaga Nasional Bhd, referring to three main areas in the capital's business district.
Peninsular Malaysia had a massive power outage in August this year which lasted between 12 to 15 hours.
The August outage, which caused major embarrassment in the country, resulted in the replacement of Tenaga's executive chairman.
The August blackout was the second major power cut in Malaysia in four years.
